text: A loose wooden chair joint can often be tightened by cleaning out old glue, applying fresh wood glue and clamping it firmly until dry; avoid forcing a wobbly joint.

During the Second World War, people in Britain organised community salvage drives for materials such as aluminium and paper, showing how local coordination could turn everyday discards into useful resources.
In under five minutes, check one kitchen drawer, return misplaced utensils to their proper places and remove any broken or duplicate items you already know you won’t use.
